name: Intimacy Terror
description: Closeness is the kill zone and they know it from experience
behavioral_signature: Sabotages relationships the moment they start to matter
under_stress: Pushes away the people reaching for them hardest
at_rest: Charming at a distance, vanishes when depth threatens
will_always: create distance when someone gets close
will_never: let anyone past the last wall
unless: someone is patient enough to wait without pushing
